notes: ACCESS: hsn.com is behind Akamai Bot Manager (desktop Chrome/Firefox/Edge curl_cffi profiles all 403 'Access Denied - edgesuite.net'; iOS/desktop Safari profiles got HTTP 200 but only the Akamai sensor JS-interstitial shell (sec-bc-tile-parent / akam-sw.js), not real content; WebFetch also 403'd; r.jina.ai hit its own Cloudflare challenge under batch contention). WORKING ROUTE: translate.goog (https://www-hsn-com.translate.goog/<path>?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=es&_x_tr_hl=en) returned full genuine server-rendered origin HTML with HTTP 200 for every listing page fetched. SHARED INFRA WITH QVC (S.N. 86): a quick check of qvc.com/home-and-garden/_/N-17h8/c.html with the same curl_cffi sweep showed the identical pattern -- chrome131 got HTTP 418, safari17_0 got HTTP 200 with a tiny (~2.6KB) body consistent with the same Akamai sensor-challenge shell HSN serves. Both Qurate Retail sibling storefronts sit behind Akamai Bot Manager with matching challenge assets, so the translate.goog bypass and the safari-profile 200-but-interstitial signature should both transfer directly to the QVC worker; catalogues themselves are separate (different product counts, different URL/category-code schemes -- HSN uses 'ho' category codes e.g. ho0074, no shared product IDs observed). ROSTER URL DEAD (Rule 3): the assigned hsn.com/shop/home/ho0354 returns a genuine origin 'Page Not Found | HSN' (confirmed via translate.goog, not just an Akamai block) -- ho0354 is a stale/retired category code. The live current Home department page (breadcrumb-confirmed root, 8215 items) is https://www.hsn.com/shop/home/ho, used as site_url instead. STRUCTURE: HSN's 'Home' super-department (8215 items) contains 14 sibling sub-departments (Bath, Bedding, Cleaning & Laundry, Furniture, Garden & Outdoors, Holiday, Home Appliances, Home Decor, Home Improvement, Lighting, Luggage & Travel, Pet Supplies, Rugs, Storage & Organization) discovered via /sitemap/ho?name=home (the mega-nav is client-JS-rendered and absent from server HTML, so the sitemap + direct department fetches were used to map the tree). Excluded entirely as non-decor: Bath (kept only its Mirrors child, see below), Bedding, Cleaning & Laundry, Furniture, Holiday (explicit Holiday & Gift exclusion), Home Appliances, Home Improvement (checked -- its 'Lighting & Electrical' child is light bulbs/switches/flashlights/doorbells, functional electrical, not fixtures), Luggage & Travel, Pet Supplies, Rugs (textile), Storage & Organization. 'Home Decor' sub-department (1258 items) breaks into Home Accents(699), Throw Pillows(181, textile-excluded), Throws(106, textile-excluded), Wall Decor(238), Window Treatments(31, verified by product-title read to be 100% curtain panels/valances, no curtain rods present -- excluded whole), plus Clocks(7, reachable only via sitemap+breadcrumb, not shown in the Home Decor page's own facet panel but breadcrumb-confirmed as Home > Home Decor > Clocks). Home Accents(699) breaks into Decorative Accents(125, kept), Picture Frames(6, kept), Vases & Urns(24, kept), Candles & Home Fragrance(53, excluded per Home Fragrance rule), Faux Plants & Wreaths(500, excluded per faux-plant rule), Indoor Plants(1, excluded -- live plant, not a decor object, negligible). Wall Decor(238) breaks into Mirrors(93), Tapestries(9), Wall Accents(41), Wall Art(96) -- all kept, all IN SCOPE decor types. 'Garden & Outdoors' dept (1034) has a 'Decor' child (524, mixed) which itself breaks into Accents/'Garden Decor'(147, kept), Fountains & Bird Baths(45, kept as decorative garden ornaments), Garden Statues & Sculptures(60, kept), Lighting/'Outdoor Lighting'(41, kept per Rule 0.1/0.5), and non-decor Arbors/Artificial Plants/Cushions & Pillows/Fencing/Mailposts/Rugs (all excluded). 'Bath' dept (110) has a Mirrors child (16 items, page titled 'Bathroom Mirrors & Mirrors and Decor for the Bathroom') kept per Rule 0.3/0.4 even though the rest of Bath (accessories, hardware, furniture, rugs & mats, shower curtains, towels, sleepwear) is excluded as bathroom fixtures/textiles; documented as a Rule 0.6 room-word overlap with the generic Mirrors(93) node -- both are genuine separate HSN department listings (different total counts, different URLs), product-ID overlap not verified. COUNT VERIFICATION (Rule 1): every leaf row's qty was confirmed TWICE -- once as the 'Departments' facet count with aria-label 'X with N products' on its parent listing page, and once again by fetching that category's own URL directly and reading its 'top-pagination-count' header ('1 to N of N items'). All 18 cross-checked nodes matched exactly with zero discrepancy (e.g. Outdoor Lighting 41=41, Bathroom Mirrors 16=16, Lamps 282=282, Wall Art 96=96), a much stronger signal than the single-source facet numbers alone -- this looks like a Searchspring/Endeca-style faceted-search platform whose totals are genuinely exact, not an inflated Shopify/Magento-style count. Parent-vs-children sums were also checked for rough consistency (e.g. Wall Decor facet children 93+9+41+96=239 vs parent's own 238; Home Decor's Home Accents+Wall Decor+Clocks+excluded textiles = ~1262 vs parent's 1258) -- both within normal cross-listing overlap noise. SCOPE NOTE: HSN's Kitchen & Dining/tableware/glassware lines live under a separate top-level 'Kitchen and Food' department (sitemap prefix 'qc', outside /shop/home/*) and were not in the assigned Home section, so not extracted here.
